core_meaning.short_meaning: A month of the Persian calendar
core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ramazan (رَمَضَان) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar, used as a given name.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: Name of a month in the Persian calendar
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ramazan corresponds to the Turkish form رَمَضَان (Turkish Ramazan, from Arabic رَمَضَان). Its core sense is ramazan; ramadan (turkish/persian form). Ramazan is the Turkish/Persian form of Arabic رَمَضَان (Ramaḍān), the ninth month of the Islamic calendar, used as a male given name. The source gloss 'Month of Fasting' is broadly consistent. Same name as ramadan.

persian.name: رمضان
persian.long_meaning: Ramazan (رمضان) نامی برگرفته از زبان ترکی است و معنای اصلی آن رمضان، ماه روزه است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

pashto.long_meaning: Ramazan (رمضان) د ترکي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې رمضان، د روژې میاشت ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: رَمَضَان
arabic.long_meaning: Ramazan (رَمَضَان) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة التركية، ومعناه الأساسي رَمَضَان (شَهْر هِجْرِيّ). يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Ramazan is a month-name turned given name: it borrows a word from the Turkish calendar and uses it to mark a child with the qualities the month evokes.

faq.a: Ramazan (رَمَضَان) is the name of a month in the traditional Persian calendar.

faq.q: What is the origin of Ramazan?
faq.a: Ramazan originates in Turkish and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
No — the recorded form رَمَضَان is Turkish, not Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Ramazan?
faq.a: No root analysis is asserted for this spelling.
Ramazan is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ramazan is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ramazan mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written رمضان and carries the sense “رمضان، روزوں کا مہینہ”.

faq.q: Is Ramazan a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Ramazan as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
